notes: Freedom Australia (SAP Commerce/Hybris + Spartacus Angular SPA; product data client-rendered via a Coveo headless commerce widget). categorysitemap.xml search for clearance/outlet/sale terms found a top-level hub /c/sale-and-clearance (breadcrumb/H1 'Sales & Clearance') plus 8 genuine URL-and-title-confirmed clearance children nested under it: clearance-bedroom-furniture, clearance-kitchen-and-tableware, clearance-living-and-dining, clearance-outdoor, clearance-office-and-storage, clearance-rugs, clearance-wallart-mirrors-and-lighting, clearance-bed-and-bath - all 8 have '/clearance/' or 'clearance-' baked into the URL path and an SSR <title> starting 'Clearance ... for Sale in Australia'. Also checked main nav 'SALE' link (routes to the same /c/sale-and-clearance hub - no separate generic promo page exists outside this hub). All 9 URLs escalated to Playwright/CDP after HTTP-only fetch showed the usual empty CSR shell; exact qty for every row was cross-confirmed by BOTH the rendered page's own 'N PRODUCTS' filter-bar text AND (for 5 of 9 rows) the intercepted Coveo commerce/v2/listing API pagination.totalProducts field - the two always matched exactly. CLEARANCE VS SALE JUDGMENT CALL (the parent hub only): the /c/sale-and-clearance page itself is a genuine PLP (525 PRODUCTS, filterable) but its own H1 is the mixed 'Sales & Clearance' (not a pure Clearance label like its 8 children), and manual inspection of the rendered product tiles showed a blend of items explicitly badged 'CLEARANCE' (e.g. ALFY Dining Chair, AUSTRIA Outdoor Umbrella & Base, SIENNA Coffee Table, FREEDOM Nimbus Mattress) alongside plain percent-off/WAS-price items with no CLEARANCE badge in categories that have no dedicated clearance child page at all (e.g. Sofas - 'GWEN Fabric Sofa', 'GWEN Fabric Flip Chaise Sofa'). Confirming this: the 8 clearance children sum to 401 products, not 525 - the parent hub's count is inflated by ~124 non-clearance Sale-only items pulled in from categories outside the 8 clearance sub-categories. Recorded the parent hub as its own row per the brief (a real, site-named PLP) but flagged it as an ambiguous mixed Sale+Clearance count rather than a clean Clearance figure. The 8 children themselves are NOT similarly flagged: each one's own breadcrumb/title/URL path is unambiguously 'Clearance' (a permanent site taxonomy node, not a temporary campaign), even though a handful of individual tiles inside them also lack a per-product CLEARANCE badge (Freedom appears to merchandise each clearance category page as 'everything currently reduced in this category', not strictly 'every item literally CLEARANCE-badged') - the page-level taxonomy signal is what the brief's test turns on, and that signal is clean and consistent for all 8. No need for Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).
